generatedFrom: 2026-11-04 workforce Excel aggregates (75 titles) + user-supplied HRSD procedural guides + project occupation catalog
scope: Every job title in dated SALIC employee sheet, not every code in national taxonomy
limits: The 37 exact guide matches are officially listed occupation reference codes, NOT Qiwa-verified employee codes.
5 catalog_partial matches are unconfirmed in a current public procedural guide; restricted project documentation is not reproduced.
30 archive_only matches rely on 2019 GASTAT taxonomy and must be confirmed against 2026 Qiwa codes.
3 titles lack exact reference code matches. No occupation codes are guessed.
HRDF employment-support targeted occupation lists mix code lengths and sector-specific incentives; they are not treated as proof of Qiwa code or SALIC regulatory obligations.
Official decisions may require entity activity, duties performed, wages, social-insurance records and certifications; all remain unverified.
